_about: Public-domain Alphonsus (Alonso) Rodriguez (1526-1616, Spanish Jesuit; not the lay brother St Alphonsus Rodriguez) in English for the Word Hoard: The Practice of Christian and Religious Perfection, translated from the French of Regnier des Marais (3 vols, Dublin: James Duffy, 1861), its first part in the London translation of 1697, and Joseph Rickaby's new translation from the Spanish (3 vols, Chicago: Loyola University Press, 1929), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

rodriguez-practice-perfection-1: The Practice of Christian and Religious Perfection, vol. I (Dublin: James Duffy, 1861)
rodriguez-practice-perfection-2: The Practice of Christian and Religious Perfection, vol. II (Dublin: James Duffy, 1861)
rodriguez-practice-perfection-3: The Practice of Christian and Religious Perfection, vol. III (Dublin: James Duffy, 1861)
rodriguez-practice-1697: The Practice of Christian Perfection, the first part, translated out of the French copy of Regnier des Marais (London: Thomas Hales; catalogued 1697)
rodriguez-practice-rickaby-1: Practice of Perfection and Christian Virtues, newly translated from the Spanish by Joseph Rickaby, vol. I (Chicago: Loyola University Press, 1929)
rodriguez-practice-rickaby-2: Practice of Perfection and Christian Virtues, tr. Joseph Rickaby, vol. II (Chicago: Loyola University Press, 1929)
rodriguez-practice-rickaby-3: Practice of Perfection and Christian Virtues, tr. Joseph Rickaby, vol. III (Chicago: Loyola University Press, 1929)

_alternates.rodriguez-copies: The undated Kenedy set and Kenedy 1899 vol. II; the Manresa Press Rickaby (1929, 2 vols)
_alternates.rodriguez-early-treatises: Saint-Omer partial translations, 1627-1632 (Mental Prayer, Humility, Modesty and Silence, and others), and The Virtue of Humility (1673)
